subject: Demo: Multi-timezone technical walkthrough & procurement next steps

Hi Marissa / Dylan,

Thanks for the quick responses on the RFP. We're excited to see Redwood in action — we need a technical demo that includes both the product overview (AE) and a deep-dive with an SE on latency/cost/kv-cache behavior. Our stakeholders: engineering leads in Bangalore (APAC), infra in Berlin (EU), and procurement in Boston (US).

Can we find a 60-minute slot that gives engineering time for questions? We realize timezones are tricky; willing to rotate to accommodate. For context, ideal attendees: 1) Samir (eng lead, Bangalore), 2) Priya (infra, Berlin), 3) Procurement team (Boston).

Proposed windows (our side):
- Tue 2026-05-19: 08:00-10:00 EDT / 13:00-15:00 BST / 17:30-19:30 IST (tight overlap)
- Wed 2026-05-20: 22:00-23:30 EDT / Thu 2026-05-21 03:00-04:30 BST / 07:30-09:00 IST (late for US)

If you have better rotating suggestions (e.g., split demo into 2 sessions: AE overview for all + SE deep-dive for engineers in a separate session), open to that.

Thanks,
Samir

Acme Robotics

- 30m AE overview (synchronous for all) to align on use cases and procurement asks
- 45m SE deep-dive scheduled at a time that hits EU/APAC better (we can record the AE overview for anyone who can't attend)

Proposed slots (all times local converted for visibility):
Option A (single 60m)
- Tue 2026-05-19 09:30 EDT / 14:30 BST / 19:00 IST
Option B (split)
- AE overview (30m): Tue 2026-05-19 09:30 EDT / 14:30 BST / 19:00 IST
- SE deep-dive (45m): Wed 2026-05-20 03:00 EDT / 08:00 BST / 12:30 IST (rotates to favor EU/APAC)

Dylan / Vivek — can you confirm availability for the SE deep-dive windows (Wed 03:00 EDT / 08:00 BST / 12:30 IST is the target)? If that is too brutal, suggest alternatives (we can also do Wed 22:00 EDT / Thu 03:00 BST / Thu 07:30 IST).
